scope: Playable Windows game: optional nonlethal limb breaker, player invincibility, super knockback, full-display dialogue bars, dedicated audio and pause menus.
platform: Windows 11 x64; Mesa 26.2.4 llvmpipe; automated audio gain tests use OpenAL null output

source_preparation.method: Reapply the complete game patch chain to all 18 SHA256-verified original sources; compare normalized text of every resulting BASIC source with the compiled tree. Reuse the unchanged Windows compiler/runtime.

checks: Actual punch contact with cheats off and on
Blocked hits, held weapons and NPC attacks excluded
All four major limbs and descendants detached; vital body parts retained
Repeated lethal damage intercepted; preexisting corpse not revived
Player health/injury protection and both dying animations
Detached effects expire after 90 simulation ticks
Character limb/health save and load roundtrip
Options entries open and save settings
Master and three category controls, mute
Both pause submenus return to the same paused scene
Disable all cheats and unmute while paused

limitations: Only the Windows compatibility game has these features; the Rust game remains an environment preview.
Limb loss persists in saves; protection lasts while its cheat is enabled.
Hardware graphics, physical controller navigation, and audible output were not tested in this pass.
